• Vì sao đúng: "The front entrance, of course — under the big lights... My cousin was already there laughing at me, holding both tickets".
• The back entrance sai: lối đó chỉ dành cho diễn viên ("Oh no, the back is only for the actors!").
• The side entrance sai: bị khóa, chỉ có tấm biển chỉ vòng ra chỗ khác ("Locked, with a little sign pointing around the building").
👉 Mẹo: các phương án chỉ khác nhau một tính từ (back/front/side). Nghe kỹ tính từ ngay trước danh từ chung, và bám vào nơi họ THỰC SỰ gặp nhau chứ không phải nơi tìm hụt.

question_text: What time do they meet?
explanation:
Man: Dinner tonight is confirmed! Now — the time. Eight o'clock like last month?
Woman: Eight was a disaster, remember? The kitchen was closing and we ate like racehorses.
Man: True. Seven, then? That's the classic hour.
Woman: Seven I'm still on the bus from my mother's, I'd arrive frazzled and starving.
Man: Then let's split the difference backwards — six thirty. The restaurant is quiet then, we get the window table, and the whole evening is ours.
Woman: Six thirty is perfect, actually. Early dinner, long talk, home before eleven like the adults we pretend to be.
Man: Six thirty, window table. Booked!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 6.30pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "let's split the difference backwards — six thirty. The restaurant is quiet then" và chốt "Six thirty, window table. Booked!".
• 8.00pm sai: lần trước 8h là thảm họa vì bếp sắp đóng cửa ("Eight was a disaster, remember? The kitchen was closing and we ate like racehorses").
• 7.00pm sai: giờ đó cô còn trên xe buýt từ nhà mẹ về ("Seven I'm still on the bus from my mother's, I'd arrive frazzled and starving").
👉 Mẹo: giờ chốt thường đi kèm hành động đặt chỗ ("Booked!", "I'll book a table"). Nghe thấy động từ này là dừng phân vân, không cần nghe lại.

question_text: Four people are talking about online shopping. Match each person to the correct information.
explanation:
Speaker A: People always say the best thing is how easy it is to send stuff back, but I've hardly ever had to return anything, so that's not it for me. For me, it was last January, when I broke my ankle and couldn't manage the stairs. The courier carried my groceries up to the third floor, the chemist's parcel turned up the next morning, and my nephew's birthday present reached him on time, even though I never left the flat. Two months indoors and I never missed a meal. The doorbell became my favourite sound in the house.
Speaker B: Some people go on about how much quicker it is, but I actually spend hours on it, so that's not my reason. My grandmother taught me never to pay the first price on the label. So I keep an eye on things for weeks, wait for the seasonal sales, stack up discount codes and pounce the moment the price hits rock bottom. The winter coat I'm wearing cost me less than half what the shop on the high street wanted. My colleagues call me stingy. I call it clever. Same coat, same label, very different receipt.
Speaker C: I don't really care that there are thousands of brands to pick from. I buy the same things every week anyway. What matters to me is this: I run a bakery, so my only day off is Tuesday, and I refuse to waste it in queues. So I do it all in stolen minutes on my phone. Flour suppliers compared while the ovens heat up, birthday presents chosen on the bus, groceries ordered over a sandwich at lunch. The hours other people spend pushing trolleys round, I spend by the river with my dog.
Speaker D: My wife won't type her card number into any website because she's convinced it'll be stolen, and to be fair, I had a scare myself last year. So it's not that I trust it. It's my daughter's feet. One is a size bigger than the other, believe it or not. Every shoe shop in town has the same fifteen styles and just shrugs. On the internet I found a company that sells odd pairs, in three colours, in her exact fit. Same with anything unusual: left-handed scissors, extra-long trousers. The high street only stocks the middle of the road.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
- The products are delivered → A: "The courier carried my groceries up to the third floor, the chemist's parcel turned up the next morning", "I never left the flat", "The doorbell became my favourite sound". Bẫy: dễ trả hàng ("easy it is to send stuff back") – "that's not it for me".
- It is cheaper → B: "never to pay the first price on the label", "pounce the moment the price hits rock bottom", "cost me less than half what the shop on the high street wanted". Bẫy: tiết kiệm thời gian ("how much quicker it is") – "I actually spend hours on it".
- It saves time → C: "my only day off is Tuesday, and I refuse to waste it in queues", "The hours other people spend pushing trolleys round, I spend by the river". Bẫy: nhiều lựa chọn ("thousands of brands to pick from") – "I buy the same things every week anyway".
- There are more choices → D: "Every shoe shop in town has the same fifteen styles", "a company that sells odd pairs, in three colours", "The high street only stocks the middle of the road". Bẫy: thanh toán an toàn – vợ sợ mất số thẻ, anh "had a scare myself", "it's not that I trust it".
- Phương án thừa: easy to return (A gạt), safe to pay online (D gạt).

infoItems.text: The products are easy to return
It is safe to pay online

question_text: A girl is talking about a show she will attend. What will end with?
options: A dance performance
A big celebration
A surprise performance
explanation:
Guess who got tickets to the summer gala — me! Saturday night, and I've done my homework on the programme. My cousin swears it ends with a dance performance, but she's thinking of the spring show — the dance troupe is touring abroad this month. The newspaper called it 'a big celebration', but that's just their fancy words for the whole evening, not the finale. The actual ending, according to the organisers themselves, is a surprise performance — a mystery guest that nobody, not even the staff, will know until the curtain. I love secrets like this!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – A surprise performance (một tiết mục bất ngờ).
• Vì sao đúng: cô dẫn nguồn chính thức "The actual ending, according to the organisers themselves, is a surprise performance — a mystery guest that nobody... will know until the curtain".
• A dance performance sai: người chị họ nhớ nhầm sang chương trình mùa xuân "she's thinking of the spring show — the dance troupe is touring abroad this month".
• A big celebration sai: chỉ là cách báo chí gọi cả buổi tối, không phải màn kết "that's just their fancy words for the whole evening, not the finale".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi KẾT THÚC BẰNG GÌ, so nguồn tin: lời đồn của người thân và báo chí thường sai. Chỉ tin nguồn "according to the organisers" và bám từ khóa chỉ phần cuối (ending, finale).

question_text: What does he advise young people to do to save money?
options: Use public transportation
Buy second-hand items
Cook for yourself
explanation:
Young listeners keep writing to ask how to save money, so here's my honest advice after thirty years of budgets. Everyone tells you to use public transport, and sure, it helps — but a bus ticket here and there is small change. Buying second-hand is fine too, though a cheap broken chair is no bargain, believe me. The real saver, the one that changes everything, is this: cook for yourself. Eating out three times a week quietly eats half a salary. Learn five simple dishes, and watch your bank account grow.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Cook for yourself.
• Vì sao đúng: "The real saver, the one that changes everything, is this: cook for yourself." — ăn ngoài 3 lần/tuần ngốn nửa tháng lương.
• Use public transportation sai: có giúp nhưng chỉ là tiền lẻ ("a bus ticket here and there is small change").
• Buy second-hand items sai: cũng ổn nhưng đồ rẻ mà hỏng thì không hời ("a cheap broken chair is no bargain").
👉 Mẹo: dạng lời khuyên, đáp án là ý được nâng lên bằng so sánh nhất "The real saver", "the one that changes everything".

question_text: Four people are talking about their journey to work. Match each person to the correct information.
explanation:
Speaker A: I used to cycle in, actually, but after a van nearly knocked me off on the ring road, the bike went back in the shed for good. These days my neighbour Tom, who works in the same building, knocks on my door at eight, and we set off on foot together. Twenty-five minutes of putting the world to rights: football, politics, his hopeless garden. Honestly, the conversation does me more good than the exercise. On the days he's off sick, the same pavement feels twice as long, and I arrive at my desk with nobody's opinions but my own.
Speaker B: There's a station five minutes from my flat, but the trains are forever being cancelled and the tickets cost a fortune, so I gave up on them last year. Now I'm a loyal passenger of the number twelve. I catch it at seven-forty from the stop outside the bakery: top deck, front row, window seat, my little office in the sky. While the traffic crawls along underneath, I read my novel or answer emails, and somebody else worries about the roadworks. A monthly pass costs less than a week of parking in town. I know who's winning.
Speaker C: A colleague who lives on my street keeps offering me a lift in his car, and every time I say no thanks. He thinks I'm mad, especially when it rains. But those thirty-five minutes on foot are the only time all day that belongs entirely to me. No chatting, no company, nobody to keep up with. Just my own thoughts wandering wherever they like. I rehearse difficult conversations, plan the weekend, and sometimes I just count the magpies. By the time I reach the office, I'm finally ready to deal with other people.
Speaker D: I used to take the bus, and I quite liked it, to be honest. Then the children started at two different schools in opposite directions, and that was the end of that. So now it's the family estate every morning: bags in the boot, arguments over the radio station, two goodbyes at two different gates, then the ring road to the office. Parking costs a fortune and the traffic really tests my patience. But with our timetable, sitting behind the wheel isn't a choice any more. It's survival, plain and simple.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
- Walk with friends → A: "knocks on my door at eight, and we set off on foot together", "Twenty-five minutes of putting the world to rights". Bẫy: xe đạp ("I used to cycle in") – "the bike went back in the shed for good".
- Go by bus → B: "a loyal passenger of the number twelve", "the stop outside the bakery: top deck, front row". Bẫy: tàu ("the trains are forever being cancelled") – "I gave up on them".
- Walk alone → C: "thirty-five minutes on foot", "No chatting, no company, nobody to keep up with". Bẫy: ô tô ("offering me a lift in his car") – "I say no thanks".
- Drive a car → D: "the family estate every morning: bags in the boot", "sitting behind the wheel isn't a choice any more". Bẫy: xe buýt ("I used to take the bus") – đã bỏ.
- Phương án thừa: Ride a bike (A đã bỏ), Take the train (B đã bỏ).

question_text: Four people are talking about outdoor activities. Match each person to the correct information.
explanation:
Speaker A: I swam for my school all the way through, but in the end I got tired of staring at the bottom of a pool, and I haven't been back in years. These days my Saturdays start at the stables before the mist lifts. I brush her down, check her hooves, and then we spend two hours crossing the fields with nothing but the sound of her steps for company. People ask if it frightens me, trusting an animal that size. It's the opposite. Up in the saddle is the calmest I feel all week.
Speaker B: My mates love camping out in the woods for the weekend, but sleeping on cold ground with insects everywhere isn't for me. What I need is much simpler. At seven, rain or shine, I lace up my trainers and head off along the canal towpath, five kilometres before the city properly wakes up. Just me, my legs and my breathing. I started because I kept losing my temper at work, and I kept at it because mornings felt unfinished without it. Last month I entered my first ten-kilometre race and crossed the line grinning like a fool.
Speaker C: My brother is always trying to get me onto a bike on those muddy forest trails, but I've got no interest in speed. My weekends are vertical. Every Sunday my club heads out to the crags with ropes and helmets rattling in the boot, and we spend the day working our way up the rock face, one hold at a time. My fingertips ache and my arms burn, but pulling myself over the top edge makes every scrape worth it. People say it's dangerous. Done properly, it's like chess with your whole body.
Speaker D: My sister keeps a horse and she's been begging me to try it, but big animals make me nervous, so I always find an excuse. Give me two wheels and chunky tyres instead. On Saturday mornings I strap everything to the roof of the car, head for the hills and spend four muddy hours flying down forest tracks and pushing back up again. The bruises are a fair price for the thrill. My wife checks the scratches on my arms every weekend and sighs. I remind her the alternative was golf, and she soon stops complaining.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
- horse riding → A: "my Saturdays start at the stables", "I brush her down, check her hooves", "Up in the saddle is the calmest I feel all week". Bẫy: bơi ("I swam for my school") – "I haven't been back in years".
- going for a run → B: "I lace up my trainers and head off along the canal towpath, five kilometres", "my first ten-kilometre race". Bẫy: cắm trại trong rừng là bạn bè – "isn't for me".
- climbing → C: "My weekends are vertical", "ropes and helmets", "working our way up the rock face, one hold at a time". Bẫy: đạp xe địa hình ("onto a bike on those muddy forest trails") – "no interest in speed".
- mountain biking → D: "two wheels and chunky tyres", "head for the hills and spend four muddy hours flying down forest tracks". Bẫy: cưỡi ngựa là chị gái – "big animals make me nervous".
- Phương án thừa: swimming (A đã bỏ), camping in the forest (B gạt).

question_text: A woman is chatting with a friend about her afternoon plans. What is she going to do this aftermoon?
options: Go on a city tour
Visit a museum
Relax at home
explanation:
Perfect timing, I was just about to text you my plans! So, this afternoon. Mum suggested the museum — there's a new exhibition — but queues on a school holiday? An hour of waiting with a hundred toddlers, no thank you. And yes, relaxing at home sounds tempting, but I've been indoors all week with that report; my sofa and I need a break from each other. So I've booked the city tour! The walking one with the funny guide everyone recommends — old town, rooftop views, secret courtyards. Three o'clock start. Jealous?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Go on a city tour (đi tour tham quan thành phố).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "So I've booked the city tour! The walking one with the funny guide everyone recommends — old town, rooftop views... Three o'clock start".
• Visit a museum sai: là gợi ý của mẹ nhưng bị loại vì xếp hàng "queues on a school holiday? An hour of waiting with a hundred toddlers, no thank you".
• Relax at home sai: cô đã ở nhà cả tuần "I've been indoors all week with that report; my sofa and I need a break from each other".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi KẾ HOẠCH CHIỀU NAY, đáp án là hoạt động ĐÃ ĐẶT/ĐÃ ĐẶT CHỖ ("I've booked...") kèm giờ cụ thể; hai lựa chọn kia luôn có câu chê ngay sau đó.

question_text: A man is calling his teacher to meet for the assignment. When is the meeting?
options: On Thursday afternoon
On Tuesday morning
On Thursday morning
explanation:
Good afternoon, Professor Hale, this is Victor from your research methods group — about our assignment meeting. Thank you for offering the slots! I checked my timetable carefully. Thursday afternoon, your first suggestion, clashes with my lab session — I can't move that, unfortunately. And Tuesday morning I'm at the hospital placement all day, so that's out too. But your third option works perfectly: Thursday morning. I'll take Thursday morning, ten o'clock, your office — and I'll bring the draft AND the questions this time. Thank you again, Professor!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Thursday morning (sáng thứ Năm).
• Vì sao đúng: Victor chốt "But your third option works perfectly: Thursday morning. I'll take Thursday morning, ten o'clock, your office".
• On Thursday afternoon sai: là gợi ý đầu tiên nhưng trùng buổi thí nghiệm "clashes with my lab session — I can't move that".
• On Tuesday morning sai: cậu đi thực tập bệnh viện cả ngày "I'm at the hospital placement all day, so that's out too".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LỊCH HẸN có 3 lựa chọn giáo viên đưa ra, nghe theo thứ tự "first suggestion / second / third option". Chỉ chọn phương án đi kèm "works perfectly", "I'll take..." và có giờ cụ thể.

question_text: Four people are talking about doing exercise. Match each person to the correct information.
explanation:
Speaker A: My wife keeps telling me a bit of jogging would help me shed a few kilos, and maybe she's right, but that's not enough to get me off the sofa. The truth is, sport and I were never meant to be together. The bike she bought me is rusting in the garage, the yoga mat has become the cat's bed, and my one visit to her aerobics class is a story her friends still ask for. I can't stand any of it: the sweat, the lycra, the cheerful instructors. Give me a slow breakfast and a crossword any day.
Speaker B: I used to jog on my own first thing in the morning, but I got bored of my own company after a month or so. Then our manager started lunchtime badminton for the staff, and within a few weeks I noticed the difference at my desk. The afternoon fog lifted, my reports came out sharper, and I stopped reading the same email four times. Now I protect that lunchtime game like a meeting with a client. Whatever it costs me in sweat, I get back in finished projects and happier bosses.
Speaker C: People assume I must hate the gym, but I don't, actually. I quite like the idea of it, and I go three times a week. It's just that every trainer I've had promises it gets easier, and it never does. Twenty minutes into any class, my lungs are begging for mercy, my legs want to head home, and the mirror shows a tomato in a tracksuit. I always finish the session, because pride won't let me quit. But I crawl to the car afterwards, completely drained, and I'm useless for the rest of the evening.
Speaker D: I tried running on my own with headphones for a while, but I gave up after about a week. The secret, for me, is company. My cousin and I turned our jogs into gossip sessions, my old classmates and I have a Sunday football game that always ends in a noisy café, and now even the neighbours join our badminton evenings. With people I like around me, two hours disappear like ten minutes and I'm laughing the whole way through. Left to myself, I wouldn't last one lap of the park.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
- hate exercising → A: "sport and I were never meant to be together", "I can't stand any of it: the sweat, the lycra, the cheerful instructors". Bẫy: giảm cân ("help me shed a few kilos") – "that's not enough to get me off the sofa".
- help improve work performance → B: "I noticed the difference at my desk", "my reports came out sharper", "I get back in finished projects". Bẫy: thích tập một mình ("jog on my own") – "got bored of my own company".
- find exercise tiring → C: "my lungs are begging for mercy", "I crawl to the car afterwards, completely drained". Bẫy thái độ gần giống: "People assume I must hate the gym, but I don't" → không phải ghét, mà là mệt.
- have fun when exercising with friends → D: "The secret, for me, is company", "With people I like around me, two hours disappear like ten minutes". Bẫy: tập một mình ("running on my own") – "I gave up".
- Phương án thừa: exercise to lose weight (A gạt), enjoy exercising alone (B và D đều đã bỏ).

infoItems.text: have fun when exercising with friends

question_text: Nate is on the phone with his friend. How long does Nate stay in India?
options: 3 days
1 week
2 weeks
explanation:
Mate, it's Nate — calling from Delhi, can you believe it, the connection is actually decent! Quick update since you asked about my plans. The original booking was just three days, you remember — the conference and straight home. Then the client meetings multiplied, so I stretched it to a week... and THEN my cousin here insisted I stay for the wedding. Long story short: I'm staying in India two weeks total. Two whole weeks! Back on the twentieth. Water my plants, feed my fish, and I'll bring you the good tea. Bye!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 2 weeks (hai tuần).
• Vì sao đúng: Nate chốt "Long story short: I'm staying in India two weeks total. Two whole weeks! Back on the twentieth".
• 3 days sai: là lịch đặt ban đầu "The original booking was just three days, you remember — the conference and straight home".
• 1 week sai: là lần gia hạn thứ nhất, sau đó còn kéo dài thêm "so I stretched it to a week... and THEN my cousin here insisted I stay for the wedding".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi Ở BAO LÂU, thời lượng bị nới dần theo trình tự. Đừng chọn mốc nghe được đầu tiên — bắt cụm tổng kết "in total", "Long story short" ở cuối bài.

question_text: Listen to the chef announce to students. When is lunch ready?
explanation:
Students, your attention in the dining hall, please — today's lunch schedule has changed, so listen up! I know the notice board still says half past twelve; that was written before the delivery truck decided to break down this morning. And no, we cannot do quarter past one either, as some of you hopefully suggested — the ovens simply need their time. Lunch will be ready at two pm. Two o'clock sharp, and to apologise for the wait, there's apple pie for everyone. Two pm — spread the word!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 2:00 p.m.
• Vì sao đúng: thông báo chốt "Lunch will be ready at two pm. Two o'clock sharp" và nhắc lại "Two pm — spread the word!".
• 12:30 p.m sai: là giờ ghi trên bảng tin trước khi xe giao hàng hỏng "the notice board still says half past twelve; that was written before the delivery truck decided to break down".
• 1:15 p.m sai: bị bác bỏ vì lò nướng cần thời gian "we cannot do quarter past one either... the ovens simply need their time".
👉 Mẹo: dạng thông báo ĐỔI GIỜ, mốc gắn với "notice board", "still says" luôn là giờ cũ. Đáp án đi kèm thì tương lai "will be ready at" và thường được lặp lại 2 lần ở cuối.

question_text: A man is talking on the phone. What did the man lose?
options: Jacket
Glasses
Books
explanation:
Hi, yes — I'm calling about your lost property box, fingers crossed! I was on the six fifteen bus from the harbour last night, upstairs, front seat. This morning's inventory: my jacket, safe — I was wearing it home, thankfully, cold as it was. My books made it too, both of them, still in my bag. But my glasses — my reading glasses in the brown leather case — are gone. I think they slid off the seat when the bus braked at the bridge. Small, gold frames, quite scratched. Please say someone handed them in — I'm reading my newspaper at arm's length here!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Glasses (kính).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "But my glasses — my reading glasses in the brown leather case — are gone", còn mô tả thêm "Small, gold frames, quite scratched".
• Jacket sai: áo khoác vẫn còn "my jacket, safe — I was wearing it home".
• Books sai: sách cũng còn đủ "My books made it too, both of them, still in my bag".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MẤT ĐỒ GÌ khi gọi lost property, người nói sẽ điểm danh từng món. Bỏ mọi món đi kèm "safe", "made it too", "still in my bag"; lấy món đi kèm "gone", "missing", "I can't find".

question_text: Listen to a woman explaining why she was late. What is the main reason she gets late?
options: Car broke down
Heavy traffic
Missed the train
explanation:
I'm so sorry everyone had to wait — let me explain this disaster of a morning. No, the car didn't break down, before anyone asks; it's in the garage all week anyway, that's old news. And the traffic was actually fine for once — the roads were practically empty. The truth is simpler and more embarrassing: I missed the train. By THIRTY seconds. I was on the platform watching it leave, and the next one wasn't for forty minutes. So here I am, with apologies and pastries for everybody!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Missed the train.
• Vì sao đúng: "The truth is simpler and more embarrassing: I missed the train. By THIRTY seconds." — chuyến sau 40 phút mới có.
• Car broke down sai: xe nằm gara cả tuần rồi, không liên quan hôm nay ("the car didn't break down... that's old news").
• Heavy traffic sai: đường hôm đó vắng ("the traffic was actually fine for once — the roads were practically empty").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do đi trễ, bám cụm "The truth is..."; các lý do kinh điển (xe hỏng, tắc đường) thường bị phủ định ngay đầu bài.

question_text: A woman tells her friend about her plans for the day. What is the woman going to do?
options: Have coffee
Have lunch
Drink tea
explanation:
My day is planned to the minute, let me tell you — Fridays are precious! People assumed I'd do the big lunch thing with the office crowd, but I've begged off — two hours of work gossip isn't rest, it's overtime. And my aunt invited me for her afternoon tea ritual, bless her, but the tiny sandwiches never fill me and I always knock something over. No — today I'm going to have coffee. Proper coffee, at the little roastery by the canal, with my book and the corner armchair. Two uninterrupted hours. Heaven!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Have coffee (đi uống cà phê).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "today I'm going to have coffee. Proper coffee, at the little roastery by the canal, with my book and the corner armchair".
• Have lunch sai: cô đã từ chối bữa trưa với đồng nghiệp "I've begged off — two hours of work gossip isn't rest, it's overtime".
• Drink tea sai: lời mời của bà dì cũng bị từ chối "the tiny sandwiches never fill me and I always knock something over".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HÔM NAY LÀM GÌ, hai phương án nhiễu thường là lời mời của người khác đã bị từ chối ("People assumed...", "my aunt invited me"). Đáp án đi sau "No — today I'm going to...".

question_text: Doctor's office is calling to change the appointment. When is the new appointment?
options: On Friday 14th
On Thursday 30th
On Thursday 13th
explanation:
Good morning, this is a message from Doctor Hansen's office regarding your check-up appointment. Unfortunately the doctor must attend a conference, so we need to reschedule. Your original slot on Friday the fourteenth is cancelled. We first offered you Thursday the thirtieth, but a nearer slot has just opened, so please ignore that. Your new appointment is Thursday the thirteenth — one day EARLIER than the original, at the same time, ten thirty. Thursday the thirteenth, ten thirty. Please call reception to confirm. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Thursday 13th (thứ Năm ngày 13).
• Vì sao đúng: tổng đài phòng khám nói "Your new appointment is Thursday the thirteenth — one day EARLIER than the original, at the same time, ten thirty".
• On Friday 14th sai: là lịch cũ đã bị hủy "Your original slot on Friday the fourteenth is cancelled".
• On Thursday 30th sai: là lịch được đề nghị trước đó rồi bỏ "We first offered you Thursday the thirtieth, but a nearer slot has just opened, so please ignore that".
👉 Mẹo: dạng ĐỔI LỊCH HẸN, bài cho 3 mốc theo thứ tự cũ → đề nghị → chính thức. Chỉ khoanh mốc đi sau "Your new appointment is", và cảnh giác hai ngày cùng là "Thursday" nhưng khác số (13 vs 30).

question_text: What is not original?
options: Furniture
Home
Bicycle
explanation:
Welcome to my little historical corner! Everyone who visits asks the same question: is it all really original? Mostly, yes! The home itself is completely authentic — these walls went up in the eighteen sixties, and even the floorboards are the ones the first family walked on. The old bicycle in the hallway is genuine too — my great-grandfather's, still with his initials. But the furniture, I must confess, is not original. The real pieces were sold long before my time, so these are careful copies, made from old photographs.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Furniture.
• Vì sao đúng: "But the furniture, I must confess, is not original... these are careful copies, made from old photographs."
• Home sai: ngôi nhà là đồ thật, xây từ thập niên 1860 ("The home itself is completely authentic").
• Bicycle sai: xe đạp của cụ cố, còn nguyên chữ khắc tên ("The old bicycle in the hallway is genuine too").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi dạng phủ định ("What is NOT original") thì chọn thứ DUY NHẤT bị chê; săn cụm "But... is not" ở cuối bài.

question_text: Listen to an auction man talking about a cabinet. Which part of the cabinet is original?
options: The drawer
The doors
The handles
explanation:
Lot forty-two, ladies and gentlemen — this handsome oak cabinet, and let me be precise about its history, as you'd expect from this house. Much has been replaced over two centuries, I won't pretend otherwise. The doors you see are Victorian replacements — well made, but a hundred years younger than the body. The brass handles are newer still, nineteen twenties at best. But the drawer — the central drawer is completely original! Note the hand-cut joints and the maker's stamp inside. That drawer alone justifies the estimate. Shall we start at four hundred?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The drawer (ngăn kéo).
• Vì sao đúng: người điều hành đấu giá nhấn mạnh "the central drawer is completely original! Note the hand-cut joints and the maker's stamp inside".
• The doors sai: là đồ thay thế thời Victoria "The doors you see are Victorian replacements — well made, but a hundred years younger than the body".
• The handles sai: còn mới hơn nữa "The brass handles are newer still, nineteen twenties at best".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi BỘ PHẬN NÀO NGUYÊN BẢN, quét từ khóa đối lập: "replacements", "newer", "younger" = loại; "completely original", "genuine" = chọn. Bằng chứng đi kèm (dấu thợ, mộng gỗ đục tay) xác nhận đáp án.

question_text: A man is ordering a drink. What does he want?
options: Water
Iced tea
Beer
explanation:
Good evening! Give me a second, it's been a long hot day... Right, drinks. My wife would tell me to just have water, and normally I would, but tonight deserves better than water, honestly. And before you suggest it — no beer for me, I'm driving the whole family home later, so that's completely out. What I'd really love is your iced tea — the homemade one with lemon I saw on the board outside? A tall glass, lots of ice, please. Actually, make it two — I'll be quick with the first!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Iced tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I'd really love is your iced tea — the homemade one with lemon... A tall glass, lots of ice, please."
• Water sai: vợ anh sẽ bảo uống nước lọc nhưng tối nay anh muốn hơn thế ("tonight deserves better than water").
• Beer sai: anh phải lái xe chở cả nhà về ("no beer for me, I'm driving the whole family home later").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi món gọi, bắt câu có động từ đặt hàng ("I'd love...", "make it two"); món gắn với lý do từ chối (đang lái xe) luôn sai.

question_text: Listen to a voice message. How does Even feel?
options: Sick
Happy
Tired
explanation:
Hey, it's Even — returning your three missed calls, sorry about that! And apologies for this croaky voice you're hearing. Before you ask: no, I'm not just tired — I actually cancelled everything and slept twelve hours last night, so rest isn't the issue. And I wish I could say I'm happy, but this week has other plans for me. Truth is, I'm sick — proper flu, the doctor confirmed it this morning: fever, aching bones, the lot. So Friday's hike is off for me, I'm afraid. I'll ring you when I'm back among the living!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Sick (bị ốm).
• Vì sao đúng: Even nói "Truth is, I'm sick — proper flu, the doctor confirmed it this morning: fever, aching bones, the lot".
• Happy sai: bị phủ định "I wish I could say I'm happy, but this week has other plans for me".
• Tired sai: cũng bị loại trực tiếp "no, I'm not just tired — I actually cancelled everything and slept twelve hours last night, so rest isn't the issue".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CẢM THẤY THẾ NÀO, đừng đoán theo giọng nói (croaky voice). Bắt cụm "Truth is, I'm..." và loại trạng thái đi sau "I'm not just...", "I wish I could say...".

question_text: Linda is talking about her mother. What do mother and daughter have in common?
options: Similar appearance
Similar interests
Similar personalities
explanation:
Everyone asks if I take after my mother, and the answer always surprises them! Looks? Not at all — she's tall and fair, I'm small and dark like Dad's side; strangers never believe we're related. Personalities? Even less — she's calm as a lake, I explode over lost keys. But our interests! That's where we're twins. We both collect old maps, we both grow orchids on every windowsill, we both watch detective series and guess the villain out loud. Same hobbies, same passions — every weekend together is a joint project!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Similar interests (sở thích giống nhau).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "But our interests! That's where we're twins" và liệt kê bằng chứng: cùng sưu tầm bản đồ cổ, cùng trồng lan, cùng xem phim trinh thám — "Same hobbies, same passions".
• Similar appearance sai: ngoại hình khác hẳn "Looks? Not at all — she's tall and fair, I'm small and dark like Dad's side".
• Similar personalities sai: tính cách còn trái ngược hơn "Even less — she's calm as a lake, I explode over lost keys".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐIỂM CHUNG, bài đi theo cấu trúc "Looks? No. Personalities? No. But...". Đáp án luôn nằm sau chữ "But" và có ít nhất hai ví dụ minh họa.

question_text: Max is calling his friend. How much can Max pay for the computer?
options: 150 pounds
250 pounds
350 pounds
explanation:
Hey, it's Max — you asked about my computer budget before we hit the second-hand fair, so here are my numbers! I originally hoped to keep it at one hundred and fifty, but let's be honest, at that price we'd be buying someone's problems. And the shiny ones your brother keeps sending me are all three fifty plus — completely outside my universe. So here's the real figure: I can pay two hundred and fifty pounds. Two fifty, cash, final ceiling — savings plus what I got for the old bike. Guard me from temptation on Saturday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: Max chốt "here's the real figure: I can pay two hundred and fifty pounds. Two fifty, cash, final ceiling".
• 150 pounds sai: là mức anh từng mong nhưng tự loại "I originally hoped to keep it at one hundred and fifty, but... at that price we'd be buying someone's problems".
• 350 pounds sai: là giá máy mới, ngoài tầm với "the shiny ones your brother keeps sending me are all three fifty plus — completely outside my universe".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi TRẢ ĐƯỢC BAO NHIÊU, phân biệt "hoped/originally" (mong muốn cũ) với "I can pay" (khả năng thật). Đáp án đi kèm từ chốt như "the real figure", "final ceiling", "budget".

question_text: Listen to the speaker talking on the radio. What is she talking about?
options: Her favorite hobby
Her journey to work
Her weekend plans
explanation:
Welcome back to Morning Radio, and today, dear listeners, I want to tell you about something I do every single day — my journey to work! You might expect me to talk about my weekend plans, they're certainly more glamorous, or my beloved pottery hobby — another day, I promise. No, today it's the journey, because mine is special: a ferry! Every morning I cross the bay — twenty minutes of seagulls, salt air and sunrise before the microphone. The best commute in radio, and I'll tell you all about it after this song!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Her journey to work (hành trình đi làm của cô).
• Vì sao đúng: MC mở đầu "I want to tell you about something I do every single day — my journey to work!" và nhấn lại "today it's the journey, because mine is special: a ferry!".
• Her favorite hobby sai: nghề gốm chỉ được hẹn dịp khác "or my beloved pottery hobby — another day, I promise".
• Her weekend plans sai: cũng chỉ được nhắc để loại "You might expect me to talk about my weekend plans... No, today it's the journey".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐANG NÓI VỀ CHỦ ĐỀ GÌ, người dẫn hay liệt kê những thứ họ KHÔNG nói hôm nay ("You might expect me to...", "another day"). Chủ đề thật đi kèm "today it's...".

question_text: How does he travel?
options: By car
By plane
By train
explanation:
My work takes me across the country twice a month, and people always assume I fly. I did try the plane for a while — but between getting to the airport two hours early and the delays, it's honestly no faster door to door. Driving? Five hours behind the wheel and I arrive useless, fit only for a nap. So now I always travel by train. Three and a half hours, a table to myself, wifi that mostly works — I finish my reports on the way and arrive fresh. The train wins every time.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – By train.
• Vì sao đúng: "So now I always travel by train. Three and a half hours, a table to myself" — anh làm xong báo cáo trên tàu.
• By car sai: lái 5 tiếng thì đến nơi kiệt sức ("I arrive useless, fit only for a nap").
• By plane sai: đã thử nhưng cộng thời gian chờ và trễ chuyến thì không nhanh hơn ("it's honestly no faster door to door").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi phương tiện hiện tại, bám trạng từ tần suất "always / now"; phương tiện đi với "I did try... but" là thứ đã bỏ.

question_text: Aman is ordering a drink. What does he want?
options: Beer
Water
Iced tea
explanation:
What a day at this street festival — my feet are finished and my throat is a desert! Right, the drinks stall. My mates are all waving their beers at me, but I'm the designated driver tonight, so beer is completely off the table. There's free water at the fountain, sensible... but after five hours of walking I deserve better than sensible, surely. What I really want is that iced tea — the fresh one with the mint and lemon they're pouring over mountains of ice. A large iced tea. Maybe two. Definitely two!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Iced tea (trà đá).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "What I really want is that iced tea — the fresh one with the mint and lemon they're pouring over mountains of ice. A large iced tea".
• Beer sai: anh là người lái xe tối nay "I'm the designated driver tonight, so beer is completely off the table".
• Water sai: có nước miễn phí nhưng anh muốn thứ ngon hơn "There's free water at the fountain, sensible... but after five hours of walking I deserve better than sensible".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GỌI ĐỒ UỐNG GÌ, bám cụm "What I really want is...". Đồ uống bị loại luôn kèm lý do cá nhân (lái xe, dị ứng, quá nhạt) — nghe ra lý do là loại được ngay.

question_text: Listen to a tour guide. Where is the office located?
options: Next to the park
Opposite the hotel
Above a restaurant
explanation:
Everyone, gather round for one practical detail before we split up — where to find me if anything goes wrong! Our tour office is your safety net today. Now, careful: it is NOT next to the park anymore — we moved out of that little kiosk last season. And whoever told you it's above a restaurant is thinking of our old branch across town. Our office is directly opposite the hotel — yes, the very hotel where you're staying! Big blue sign, can't miss it, open until nine tonight. Right — cameras ready, let's explore!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Opposite the hotel (đối diện khách sạn).
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên chỉ rõ "Our office is directly opposite the hotel — yes, the very hotel where you're staying! Big blue sign, can't miss it".
• Next to the park sai: là địa chỉ cũ đã bỏ "it is NOT next to the park anymore — we moved out of that little kiosk last season".
• Above a restaurant sai: đó là chi nhánh cũ ở khu khác "whoever told you it's above a restaurant is thinking of our old branch across town".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi VĂN PHÒNG/ĐỊA ĐIỂM Ở ĐÂU, chú ý các từ chỉ quá khứ: "anymore", "last season", "old branch" = loại. Đáp án luôn kèm mô tả nhận diện cụ thể (biển hiệu, màu sắc).

question_text: Listen to the woman talking about her holiday plans. Where is she going next?
options: The east
The north
The south
explanation:
Holiday planning time — my favourite season of the year! Everyone assumes I'll go east again, to the lakes; lovely, but I've done it three years straight and even the ducks recognise me now. My brother keeps pushing the north — the mountains, the cold hikes... he forgets I hate being cold ON PURPOSE. No — this year I'm going to the south! Two weeks on the southern coast: fishing villages, warm sea, oranges straight from the tree. The tickets are booked, the sun cream is bought. South, here I come!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The south (miền Nam).
• Vì sao đúng: cô chốt "this year I'm going to the south! Two weeks on the southern coast: fishing villages, warm sea, oranges" và đã "The tickets are booked, the sun cream is bought".
• The east sai: đó là nơi đã đi ba năm liền "I've done it three years straight and even the ducks recognise me now".
• The north sai: là gợi ý của anh trai nhưng cô ghét lạnh "he forgets I hate being cold ON PURPOSE".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐI ĐÂU (hướng/địa danh), loại ngay nơi đi kèm "again", "three years straight" (đã đi rồi) và nơi do người khác đề xuất. Đáp án có bằng chứng hành động: đã đặt vé, đã mua đồ.

question_text: What did the mother call her daughter to help her buy?
options: eggs
bread
milk
explanation:
Sweetheart, it's Mum — catch this message before you leave the office! Small kitchen emergency: I'm in the middle of baking the birthday cake for Grandpa, and I've just realised I'm short on eggs. I need six more — six large eggs, the free-range ones from the corner shop if they have them. That's all, just the eggs! We have plenty of bread, don't buy more, it'll only go hard. Milk we're fine for too, the fridge is full. Just the eggs, darling — quick as you can! Love you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Eggs.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm short on eggs. I need six more — six large eggs" và mẹ nhắc lại "Just the eggs, darling".
• Bread sai: nhà còn nhiều, mẹ dặn đừng mua thêm kẻo cứng ("We have plenty of bread, don't buy more").
• Milk sai: tủ lạnh vẫn đầy ("Milk we're fine for too, the fridge is full").
👉 Mẹo: dạng nhờ mua đồ, bám cụm giới hạn "just / only"; món đi với "don't buy" hay "we're fine for" là bẫy.

question_text: Mary is talking to her friend about her new home. What does she ask her friend about?
options: Where to buy a new table
The furniture
Mirror
explanation:
Sofia, it's Mary — I need your shopping wisdom, you're the queen of finding things! The new flat is coming together: the mirror your sister gave us is already up in the hallway, looks perfect, thank her again. And the furniture from the old place fitted better than we feared — sofa, shelves, all in. But we're missing one big thing: a dining table. So my question is — where should I buy a new table? You found that gorgeous oak one of yours somewhere secret. Which shop? Call me back with the address, please!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Where to buy a new table (mua bàn ăn mới ở đâu).
• Vì sao đúng: Mary hỏi thẳng "But we're missing one big thing: a dining table. So my question is — where should I buy a new table?... Which shop?".
• The furniture sai: nội thất cũ đã ổn định "the furniture from the old place fitted better than we feared — sofa, shelves, all in".
• Mirror sai: gương đã treo xong "the mirror your sister gave us is already up in the hallway, looks perfect".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CÔ ẤY HỎI VỀ ĐIỀU GÌ, đừng chọn đồ vật được nhắc nhiều nhất. Tìm đúng câu có dấu hỏi ("So my question is — where...?") vì đó mới là nội dung nhờ vả.

question_text: Listen to the announcement. When does the train leave?
explanation:
Attention please, passengers for the morning express to the capital. There has been confusion on the boards, so please listen carefully to this correction. The printed timetable in the hall still shows nine thirty — that time changed last month and the poster, regrettably, did not. And this morning's earlier announcement of nine forty-five was an error by our new colleague, our apologies. The correct departure: the train leaves at nine fifteen. Nine one five, platform three. That is in twelve minutes, so please make your way there now. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At 9:15.
• Vì sao đúng: thông báo sửa lại "The correct departure: the train leaves at nine fifteen. Nine one five, platform three".
• At 9.30 sai: là giờ trên bảng in chưa cập nhật "The printed timetable in the hall still shows nine thirty — that time changed last month".
• At 9.45 sai: là thông báo nhầm của nhân viên mới "this morning's earlier announcement of nine forty-five was an error by our new colleague".
👉 Mẹo: dạng thông báo CẢI CHÍNH GIỜ, nghe cụm "The correct departure/time is...". Mọi mốc gắn với "printed timetable", "earlier announcement", "error" đều là bẫy dù được đọc trước.

question_text: Listening to Sarah leaving a message for her friend. When does she want to meet?
options: Two o'clock
Three o'clock
One o'clock
explanation:
Hi Rachel, it's Sarah — voicemail again, we truly are phone-tag champions! About tomorrow's catch-up, I've shuffled my whole day. One o'clock is dead on arrival — that's my dentist slot, immovable, I've begged. Two o'clock I first suggested myself... and then remembered the school bake sale runs till half past two, and I'm on cake duty. So: three o'clock! I want to meet at three, at the garden café, corner table. A full hour, cake included — I'll bring the leftovers from the sale. Text me a yes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Three o'clock (3 giờ).
• Vì sao đúng: Sarah chốt "So: three o'clock! I want to meet at three, at the garden café, corner table".
• One o'clock sai: vướng lịch nha sĩ không dời được "that's my dentist slot, immovable, I've begged".
• Two o'clock sai: chính cô đề xuất rồi tự rút lại "I first suggested myself... and then remembered the school bake sale runs till half past two, and I'm on cake duty".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIỜ HẸN, cẩn thận mốc do chính người nói đề xuất rồi tự hủy ("I first suggested... and then remembered"). Chỉ lấy mốc đứng sau "So:" kèm địa điểm cụ thể.

question_text: Where does Malik want to go?
options: The town hall
The library
The park
explanation:
Excuse me! Sorry to stop you — I'm Malik, I'm new to this neighbourhood, and my phone has just died completely. Could you point me somewhere? I'm trying to get to the town hall — I have an appointment at the residents' office in twenty minutes to register my new address. I know the library is somewhere on this street, and the park is behind me, but the town hall has me completely lost. Is it far? Should I take a bus, or can I walk from here? Thank you so much!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The town hall.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm trying to get to the town hall — I have an appointment at the residents' office in twenty minutes to register my new address."
• The library sai: chỉ là mốc anh đã biết vị trí ("I know the library is somewhere on this street").
• The park sai: cũng chỉ là mốc, đang ở ngay sau lưng anh ("the park is behind me").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi đích đến, chọn nơi đi với "I'm trying to get to"; những nơi người nói đã biết vị trí chỉ là mốc định hướng.

question_text: Louis is calling his friend Standar. Where will Luis meet Standar?
options: Outside the station
At the cafe
Near the ticket counter
explanation:
Standar, it's Louis — about meeting tomorrow before the train, final plan, so listen! NOT the café this time; the one at the station closed for renovation last week, there's just a sad curtain where the coffee machine was. And don't stand by the ticket counter either — they've moved it upstairs and the queue blocks the whole corridor, total chaos. Meet me outside the station — by the main doors, next to the big clock. Nine fifteen, outside, big clock. If it rains, I'll have the blue umbrella. See you there!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Outside the station (bên ngoài nhà ga).
• Vì sao đúng: Louis dặn "Meet me outside the station — by the main doors, next to the big clock. Nine fifteen, outside, big clock".
• At the cafe sai: quán đã đóng cửa sửa chữa "NOT the café this time; the one at the station closed for renovation last week".
• Near the ticket counter sai: quầy vé đã chuyển lên tầng và tắc nghẽn "they've moved it upstairs and the queue blocks the whole corridor, total chaos".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẸN Ở ĐÂU, hai chỗ bị loại thường đi kèm "closed", "moved", "NOT". Đáp án luôn có mốc nhận diện phụ (đồng hồ lớn, cửa chính) — nghe được mốc phụ là chắc chắn đúng.

question_text: Listening to a woman's announcement. Where will they wait for the bus?
options: Behind the hotel's main entrance
By the hotel's main entrance
By the hotel's side entrance
explanation:
Good evening, everyone — final details for tomorrow's excursion, please remember them over dinner! The bus situation first. Do NOT wait behind the hotel — I know the shade is lovely back there, but the driver cannot even enter that street, it's pedestrians only. And the side entrance by the pool is locked before nine, so that's no good either. We will wait for the bus by the hotel's main entrance — right by the front steps and the flags. Seven forty-five, main entrance, cameras charged. Sleep well, everyone!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the hotel's main entrance (ngay cổng chính khách sạn).
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên dặn "We will wait for the bus by the hotel's main entrance — right by the front steps and the flags. Seven forty-five, main entrance".
• Behind the hotel's main entrance sai: xe không vào được phía sau "Do NOT wait behind the hotel... the driver cannot even enter that street, it's pedestrians only".
• By the hotel's side entrance sai: cửa hông bị khóa "the side entrance by the pool is locked before nine".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CHỜ Ở ĐÂU, ba phương án chỉ khác nhau một giới từ/vị trí (behind – side – main). Nghe trọn cụm giới từ chứ đừng bắt mỗi chữ "entrance", và ưu tiên câu bắt đầu bằng "We will wait...".

question_text: Listen to a woman giving advice on saving money. What advice does she give to save money?
options: Buy in bulk
Use the public transport
Put money into the bank
explanation:
Welcome back to Money Matters! Today: my number one tip for saving, especially for you city listeners. People expect me to say buy in bulk — but honestly, half those giant packets expire before you finish them; I've thrown away more bulk rice than I dare admit. Putting money into the bank is fine, but with these interest rates it's storage, not strategy. My real advice: use public transport! Do the maths — petrol, parking, insurance, repairs... a monthly travel card costs a fraction of a car. Hundreds saved, every single month. Sell the car, buy the card!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Use the public transport (dùng phương tiện công cộng).
• Vì sao đúng: chuyên gia chốt "My real advice: use public transport!" và tính rõ "a monthly travel card costs a fraction of a car. Hundreds saved, every single month".
• Buy in bulk sai: bị bác bỏ vì lãng phí "half those giant packets expire before you finish them; I've thrown away more bulk rice than I dare admit".
• Put money into the bank sai: chỉ là cất giữ, không sinh lời "with these interest rates it's storage, not strategy".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LỜI KHUYÊN TIẾT KIỆM, người nói luôn nêu cái mọi người TƯỞNG trước ("People expect me to say..."). Đáp án nằm sau "My real advice is..." và kèm con số/phép tính minh chứng.

question_text: Listen to a woman talking about what she has just bought. What is Dress she wears like?
options: black and white
long and white
long and red
explanation:
I did it — I finally bought THE dress, and you need to hear about it! The shop had three finalists, let me set the scene. A black and white one, very elegant, very... funeral-meets-chessboard, my mum loved it, which settled that. Then a long white one — dreamy, but I'd stain it within the hour, we all know me. The winner, the one I'm wearing to the reunion: long and red! Floor-length, deep wine red, little sparkles at the hem. I twirled in the changing room like a five-year-old. No regrets!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – long and red (váy dài màu đỏ).
• Vì sao đúng: cô công bố "The winner, the one I'm wearing to the reunion: long and red! Floor-length, deep wine red, little sparkles at the hem".
• black and white sai: bị loại vì trông như đồ tang/bàn cờ và vì mẹ thích "very... funeral-meets-chessboard, my mum loved it, which settled that".
• long and white sai: đẹp nhưng dễ bẩn "dreamy, but I'd stain it within the hour, we all know me".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MÔ TẢ ĐỒ VẬT (màu/kiểu), bài dựng như một cuộc thi 3 ứng viên. Đợi từ "The winner", "the one I bought/I'm wearing" rồi mới ghép đủ cả hai đặc điểm (độ dài + màu).

question_text: What area is he describing?
options: A shopping district
A university area
A residential neighborhood
explanation:
Let me describe the area where I've just moved, because it has a very particular energy. Don't picture a shopping district — there's just one small supermarket and a kiosk, that's the whole retail scene. And it's not a quiet residential neighbourhood either, definitely not; nobody here is retired, trust me. This is a university area through and through: three faculties within ten minutes' walk, bookshops and cheap cafés on every corner, bicycles everywhere, and the streets full of students until two in the morning. The average age here must be twenty-two!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A university area.
• Vì sao đúng: "This is a university area through and through: three faculties within ten minutes' walk... the streets full of students until two in the morning."
• A shopping district sai: bị phủ định ngay ("Don't picture a shopping district — there's just one small supermarket and a kiosk").
• A residential neighborhood sai: cũng bị phủ định ("it's not a quiet residential neighbourhood either, definitely not").
👉 Mẹo: dạng miêu tả khu vực, đếm hai câu "Don't picture..." / "it's not..." để loại; đáp án là câu khẳng định "This is a...".

question_text: A woman is going home after shopping. What did she buy?
options: A dress
A blouse
A hat
explanation:
I'm on the bus home and I have to tell SOMEONE about my shopping victory! The plan this morning was a blouse for the office — but every single one was either see-through or the colour of sadness, so that mission failed. Then I detoured past the hats, tried on a big summer one, looked like a lost mushroom — photo deleted forever. But THEN, on the last rail by the till: the dress. Simple, navy, fits like a dream, thirty percent off. I bought the dress on the spot! Sometimes the shopping gods just smile at you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A dress (một chiếc váy).
• Vì sao đúng: cô kể "But THEN, on the last rail by the till: the dress. Simple, navy, fits like a dream, thirty percent off. I bought the dress on the spot!".
• A blouse sai: đó là mục tiêu ban đầu nhưng thất bại "every single one was either see-through or the colour of sadness, so that mission failed".
• A hat sai: chỉ thử chứ không mua "tried on a big summer one, looked like a lost mushroom — photo deleted forever".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐÃ MUA GÌ, phân biệt "the plan was..." / "tried on" (chỉ định mua, chỉ thử) với "I bought". Đáp án đi kèm hành động mua dứt khoát ("bought... on the spot") và chi tiết giá/khuyến mãi.

question_text: A woman is talking about her babysitter. How old is the babysitter?
explanation:
Our new babysitter is an absolute treasure — let me tell you about her! When she first rang the doorbell, I honestly thought she was twenty at most, she has such a young face. Then over coffee she mentioned finishing her second year at university, and my husband guessed twenty-two. Wrong too! We saw her ID when we did the paperwork: she's twenty-one. Twenty-one, studying early childhood education, and the kids adore her — they actually ask when she's coming back. Worth every penny!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 21 tuổi.
• Vì sao đúng: người mẹ dẫn bằng chứng giấy tờ "We saw her ID when we did the paperwork: she's twenty-one. Twenty-one, studying early childhood education".
• 20 sai: chỉ là cảm nhận ban đầu vì cô bé trông trẻ "I honestly thought she was twenty at most, she has such a young face".
• 22 sai: là phỏng đoán của người chồng và bị bác bỏ "my husband guessed twenty-two. Wrong too!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi BAO NHIÊU TUỔI, luôn có 2 con số phỏng đoán ("I thought", "guessed") và 1 con số có bằng chứng (ID, giấy tờ, hồ sơ). Chọn con số gắn với bằng chứng.

question_text: A man is talking to a friend about his family. What is his main problem?
options: Persuading his family
Finding a job abroad
Saving money for the move
explanation:
The big move abroad — everyone asks how it's going, so here's the honest update. The job part? Sorted, actually — the company found me a position in their Lisbon office within a month; finding work abroad was never the issue. Money's fine too — we've saved for three years, the moving fund is healthy. My real problem lives in my own house: persuading the family! My wife worries about her parents, the kids refuse to leave their friends, and Sunday dinners have become negotiation sessions. The visas are easy — it's my own kitchen table that's the battlefield!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Persuading his family (thuyết phục gia đình).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "My real problem lives in my own house: persuading the family!" — vợ lo cho bố mẹ, con không muốn xa bạn, "it's my own kitchen table that's the battlefield".
• Finding a job abroad sai: việc làm đã xong "the company found me a position in their Lisbon office within a month; finding work abroad was never the issue".
• Saving money for the move sai: tiền cũng đủ "Money's fine too — we've saved for three years, the moving fund is healthy".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi VẤN ĐỀ CHÍNH, bài sẽ "dọn" các khó khăn đã giải quyết trước bằng "sorted", "fine too", "never the issue". Đáp án đi sau "My real problem is...".

question_text: A man wants to buy a new house. What is his biggest problem?
options: Finding the right house
Persuading his family
Getting the financing
explanation:
So, the big house-buying project — everyone asks how it's going. Here's the funny thing: the parts I feared went smoothly. Finding the right house? Done in a month — a lovely place near the school, garden and all. The financing scared me most, but the bank approved the loan in two weeks, no drama. No — my real problem is persuading my own family! My wife says the kitchen is too small, my daughter refuses to change schools, and even the dog seems against it. Wish me luck at dinner tonight — final negotiations!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Persuading his family.
• Vì sao đúng: "my real problem is persuading my own family!" — vợ chê bếp nhỏ, con gái không chịu đổi trường.
• Finding the right house sai: đã xong trong một tháng ("Done in a month — a lovely place near the school").
• Getting the financing sai: ngân hàng duyệt khoản vay trong hai tuần, không rắc rối ("no drama").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "biggest problem", bỏ mọi việc đã hoàn tất; bám cụm "my real problem is" đứng ngay sau "No —".

question_text: Linda is talking about what she likes to eat. What does she have for lunch?
options: Tea
Coffee
Juice
explanation:
People at work tease me about my lunch ritual, so let me explain it properly! My name's Linda, and yes, I'm particular. The others line up at the coffee machine after eating — not me; coffee after midday keeps me wired till two in the morning. Juice? Too sweet with a meal, I find, more of a breakfast thing. What I have with lunch, every single day, is tea. A proper pot of black tea, no sugar, splash of milk, brewed exactly four minutes. My little island of calm in the working day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Tea (trà).
• Vì sao đúng: Linda nói "What I have with lunch, every single day, is tea. A proper pot of black tea, no sugar, splash of milk".
• Coffee sai: đó là thói quen của đồng nghiệp, còn cô tránh vì mất ngủ "The others line up at the coffee machine after eating — not me; coffee after midday keeps me wired till two in the morning".
• Juice sai: cô cho là không hợp bữa trưa "Too sweet with a meal, I find, more of a breakfast thing".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĂN/UỐNG GÌ, phân biệt "the others" với "me". Đáp án đi kèm cụm chỉ tần suất "every single day" và mô tả chi tiết cách dùng.

question_text: Two friends are discussing a movie they recently watched. What elements of the film do they agree on?
options: The music
The ending
The characters
explanation:
M: Okay, verdict time — the film last night. Loved it or hated it?
W: Mixed! The music, for a start — that soundtrack carried half the scenes for me.
M: Really? I found the music too loud, honestly — it kept drowning the dialogue.
W: Philistine! Fine — the characters, then. The detective was brilliant, admit it.
M: The detective mumbled his way through two hours! I couldn't connect with any of them.
W: We agree on NOTHING today. Except... be honest about the ending.
M: Ah, the ending. The twist on the train — I did NOT see that coming. Genuinely great.
W: Neither did I! I actually gasped out loud, ask my sister.
M: So there it is: music, no; characters, no; but the ending — the ending we both loved.
W: One out of three. For us, that's harmony!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The ending (đoạn kết).
• Vì sao đúng: người đàn ông tổng kết "music, no; characters, no; but the ending — the ending we both loved", cả hai đều bất ngờ với "The twist on the train — I did NOT see that coming".
• The music sai: hai người trái ý nhau — cô khen "that soundtrack carried half the scenes", anh chê "I found the music too loud... it kept drowning the dialogue".
• The characters sai: cũng bất đồng — cô khen thám tử xuất sắc, anh chê "The detective mumbled his way through two hours!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HAI NGƯỜI ĐỒNG Ý ĐIỀU GÌ, phải nghe cả hai lượt nói về từng yếu tố. Chỉ khoanh yếu tố mà cả hai cùng khen, thường có từ "both", "Neither did I", "We agree on...".

question_text: What time do they meet?
explanation:
M: Tonight's dinner — what time should we meet at the restaurant?
W: Well, the table is booked for eight, so we could just meet then?
M: Eight is when we SIT, though. If we meet at eight we'll be flustered and hungry.
W: True. Seven, then? That gives us an hour to spare.
M: Seven I can't do — my train only gets in at ten past.
W: Hmm. So... what about half past six — wait, no, that's before your train. Six thirty won't work for YOU.
M: Actually it will! There's an earlier train at five forty — I'll just take that one. Six thirty at the little bar next door, drinks before dinner?
W: Perfect. Six thirty at the bar, eight at the table. It's a plan!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 6.30pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "Six thirty at the little bar next door, drinks before dinner?" — cô chốt "Six thirty at the bar, eight at the table".
• 8.00pm sai: đó là giờ ĐẶT BÀN chứ không phải giờ gặp nhau ("Eight is when we SIT, though").
• 7.00pm sai: tàu của anh 7 giờ 10 mới tới ("my train only gets in at ten past").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "What time do they MEET" khác giờ đặt bàn. Xác định đúng động từ trong câu hỏi rồi mới chọn mốc tương ứng.

question_text: A man is talking to a shop assistant. What does the man buy in the shop?
options: Mugs
Candles
Clothes
explanation:
W: Welcome in! Shopping for yourself today, or a gift?
M: A birthday present for my brother — and I'm hopeless at this, help me.
W: That's my job! These ceramic mugs are popular — we can print his name on one.
M: He works from home with exactly one mug he loves. A second one would just gather dust.
W: Understood. Scented candles, then? The sandalwood set is lovely.
M: He has allergies — one whiff of perfume and he sneezes for a week. Hard no.
W: Then let's look at clothes. What's he like?
M: Outdoorsy, always cold, always in the same worn-out jumper...
W: Say no more — this wool jumper, and the flannel shirts are on offer too.
M: The navy jumper AND a shirt. Perfect — clothes it is, wrapped please!
W: Excellent choice. Brothers always need rescuing from their old jumpers!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Clothes (quần áo).
• Vì sao đúng: anh chốt mua "The navy jumper AND a shirt. Perfect — clothes it is, wrapped please!" sau khi nhân viên gợi ý "this wool jumper, and the flannel shirts are on offer too".
• Mugs sai: em trai đã có cốc ruột "He works from home with exactly one mug he loves. A second one would just gather dust".
• Candles sai: bị từ chối thẳng vì dị ứng "He has allergies — one whiff of perfume and he sneezes for a week. Hard no".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MUA GÌ trong hội thoại bán hàng, nhân viên sẽ chào 3 món. Chỉ tính món khách nói "I'll take/wrapped please"; mọi món bị "Hard no", "would just gather dust" là loại.

question_text: Two colleges talk about meeting. When do they want to meet?
options: On Tuesday
On Sunday
On Saturday
explanation:
M: We need this planning session soon — the deadline won't wait. Which day works?
W: Not the weekend, please. Saturday I'm at my niece's christening — all day, church shoes and everything.
M: Saturday's out then. Sunday? Just the morning?
W: Sunday the office building is locked, remember? No badge access, we learned that the hard way last month.
M: Ah yes, the car park picnic. Never again. So it has to be a weekday...
W: Tuesday! Tuesday my calendar is empty until four, and the meeting room is free — I just checked.
M: Tuesday works for me too. Nine o'clock, big whiteboard, and I'll bring the good coffee.
W: Tuesday at nine, then. And this time we finish the WHOLE plan before lunch!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Tuesday (thứ Ba).
• Vì sao đúng: cô đề xuất "Tuesday! Tuesday my calendar is empty until four, and the meeting room is free" và cả hai chốt "Tuesday at nine, then".
• On Saturday sai: cô bận lễ rửa tội cả ngày "Saturday I'm at my niece's christening — all day, church shoes and everything".
• On Sunday sai: tòa nhà văn phòng khóa cửa "Sunday the office building is locked, remember? No badge access".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẸN NGÀY NÀO giữa hai đồng nghiệp, đáp án là ngày duy nhất KHÔNG bị nêu trở ngại và được cả hai xác nhận lại. Nghe câu tổng kết cuối "X at nine, then".

question_text: Listen to the conversation between Douglas and Kay. Why does Douglas call Kay?
options: ask for a favor
suggest a meeting
say thank you
explanation:
W: Hello? Douglas! This is unexpected — everything alright?
M: Everything's wonderful, Kay — and this call is overdue, actually.
W: Uh oh. Let me guess: your printer died again and you need mine?
M: Ha! No favours today, I promise — the printer is alive and well.
W: Then you want to set up one of your famous project meetings?
M: Not that either — no agendas, no calendars. Kay, I'm calling to say thank you. Properly, out loud.
W: Thank me? Whatever for?
M: The recommendation letter you wrote — I got the position! They told me yesterday your letter is what tipped the scales. You changed my whole year with one page, Kay.
W: Douglas, that's WONDERFUL news! But your work did the real talking.
M: We'll argue about that over dinner — my treat, Friday, no refusals. It's the least a grateful man can do!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – say thank you (để nói lời cảm ơn).
• Vì sao đúng: Douglas nói rõ "Kay, I'm calling to say thank you. Properly, out loud" — cảm ơn lá thư giới thiệu đã giúp anh trúng tuyển "The recommendation letter you wrote — I got the position!".
• ask for a favor sai: bị phủ định "No favours today, I promise — the printer is alive and well".
• suggest a meeting sai: cũng bị phủ định "Not that either — no agendas, no calendars".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MỤC ĐÍCH CUỘC GỌI, người nghe sẽ đoán sai 2 lần và bị bác bỏ liên tiếp. Đáp án nằm ở cấu trúc "I'm calling to + V" — nghe kỹ ngay sau hai lần "No".

question_text: A man is talking to the shopping assistant. What color top does he buy?
options: Red
Blue
Black
explanation:
W: Hello there! Hunting for anything special?
M: A new top — my sister's graduation is Saturday and apparently my wardrobe is 'a disgrace', her words.
W: Sisters keep us honest! This red one is bold — very celebratory?
M: Bold is the word... I'd outshine the graduate, and she'd never forgive me. Safer options?
W: The blue, then — calm, classic. Although I should check the sizes... yes, sadly only extra small left in blue.
M: Definitely not my size! And that one, the dark one on the mannequin?
W: The black — our bestseller. Every size, and it works for graduations, dinners, everything really.
M: Perfect. The black one in large, please — and if my sister disapproves, I'm sending her here.
W: Deal! She'll approve — black never fails. That's twenty-two fifty, please.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black (màu đen).
• Vì sao đúng: anh chốt "The black one in large, please" sau khi nhân viên giới thiệu "The black — our bestseller. Every size, and it works for graduations".
• Red sai: quá nổi bật trong lễ tốt nghiệp của em gái "I'd outshine the graduate, and she'd never forgive me".
• Blue sai: hết size vừa "sadly only extra small left in blue" — anh đáp "Definitely not my size!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MÀU/MÓN ĐÃ MUA, phương án nhiễu bị loại vì hai lý do kinh điển: không hợp hoàn cảnh hoặc hết size. Chỉ tính màu đi kèm câu đặt hàng có size ("the black one in large, please").

question_text: A mom is talking to her son. What does the son like to study?
options: Art
Math
Science
explanation:
W: Sweetheart, we need to talk about your subjects for next year. Your dad thinks you should focus on math.
M: Mum, we both know I count on my fingers. Math and I are not friends.
W: Science, then? Uncle Pete could help you — he loves his laboratory.
M: The experiments are okay... but honestly, I only enjoy drawing the diagrams, not doing the science.
W: Wait — drawing the diagrams? Is that a hint?
M: It's more than a hint, Mum. What I really like to study is art. It's the only class where three hours feel like ten minutes. My teacher says my portfolio is the best in the year.
W: She actually told me the same at the parents' evening. Alright, my artist — art it is. Your dad will survive.
M: Thanks, Mum! First portrait is of you, I promise.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Art.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I really like to study is art. It's the only class where three hours feel like ten minutes."
• Math sai: bố gợi ý nhưng cậu thừa nhận rất kém ("we both know I count on my fingers").
• Science sai: cậu chỉ thích phần vẽ sơ đồ chứ không thích làm khoa học ("I only enjoy drawing the diagrams, not doing the science").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi môn yêu thích, ý kiến của bố mẹ hay chú bác luôn là nhiễu; chọn môn đứng sau "What I really like to study is".

question_text: Anna is calling her friend. Where will they meet?
options: At the marketplace
At the mall
At the park
explanation:
W: Hey, it's Anna! Are we still on for Saturday morning?
M: Absolutely! Just tell me where — last time we had three plans at once.
W: Right, let's fix it properly. NOT the mall — it's the first Saturday of the sales, we'd be trampled.
M: Agreed, I value my life. The park? The weather app promises sunshine.
W: The same app promised sunshine at the lake festival, remember? We swam home.
M: Never again. So...?
W: The marketplace! The farmers' stalls are back this week — fresh bread, the cheese man, the flower lady. We'll meet at the marketplace, by the fountain, ten o'clock.
M: Marketplace, fountain, ten. And breakfast at the bread stall is on me!
W: That's why we're friends. See you Saturday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At the marketplace (ở khu chợ).
• Vì sao đúng: Anna chốt "The marketplace!... We'll meet at the marketplace, by the fountain, ten o'clock" và bạn cô nhắc lại "Marketplace, fountain, ten".
• At the mall sai: bị loại ngay từ đầu "NOT the mall — it's the first Saturday of the sales, we'd be trampled".
• At the park sai: bị loại vì không tin dự báo thời tiết "The same app promised sunshine at the lake festival, remember? We swam home".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GẶP Ở ĐÂU, đáp án thường được nhắc lại hai lần (một người nói, một người xác nhận). Nghe kỹ câu nhắc lại kèm mốc phụ (đài phun nước, 10 giờ) để chốt.

question_text: A man is seeking advice on future career. What is he going to do?
options: To work in business
To become a teacher
To study at college
explanation:
M: Thanks for making time — I need your honest advice about my next step. Everyone has an opinion and I'm drowning.
W: That's what mentors are for! Tell me the options on your table.
M: Teaching, first. My mother's dream for me, and I did enjoy tutoring...
W: But?
M: But two weeks of classroom practice showed me the patience required — and mine ran out by Wednesday morning.
W: Honest, good. And more studying? College?
M: I looked at it, truly — but four more years of lectures and loans, at my age? My savings said absolutely not.
W: So that leaves the thing your eyes light up about...
M: Business. I'm going to work in business — the trading firm offered me a junior position, and every cell in me says yes.
W: Then trust that. You've thought it through better than you realise.
M: Signing the contract Monday. Thank you — I just needed to hear myself say it!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To work in business (đi làm trong ngành kinh doanh).
• Vì sao đúng: anh khẳng định "Business. I'm going to work in business — the trading firm offered me a junior position, and every cell in me says yes", và "Signing the contract Monday".
• To become a teacher sai: anh tự thấy không đủ kiên nhẫn "two weeks of classroom practice showed me the patience required — and mine ran out by Wednesday morning".
• To study at college sai: loại vì tiền và tuổi "four more years of lectures and loans, at my age? My savings said absolutely not".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HƯỚNG NGHỀ NGHIỆP, mỗi phương án sai đều kèm một chữ "But". Đáp án là lựa chọn duy nhất KHÔNG bị phản bác và có hành động cụ thể (được mời làm, ký hợp đồng).

question_text: A man is talking to a waiter. What drink does the man choose?
options: Milk tea
Hot tea
Iced tea
explanation:
W: Good afternoon, sir! Ready to order, or shall I give you a minute?
M: Just drinks for now, please — I'm melting after that walk.
W: Then may I suggest our milk tea? House specialty, very popular.
M: Tempting, but milk and this heat don't mix for me, I'm afraid.
W: Understood! Hot tea, perhaps? Some say it actually cools you down.
M: My grandmother says that too — I've never believed either of you! No... something COLD.
W: Then you want our iced tea: fresh-brewed, lemon, mint, and a glass full of ice.
M: THAT's the one. A large iced tea, please — and keep them coming.
W: One large iced tea, right away. The refills are free until four, sir — you picked the right day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Iced tea (trà đá).
• Vì sao đúng: khách chốt "THAT's the one. A large iced tea, please" sau khi phục vụ mô tả "our iced tea: fresh-brewed, lemon, mint, and a glass full of ice".
• Milk tea sai: bị từ chối vì trời nóng "Tempting, but milk and this heat don't mix for me".
• Hot tea sai: khách không tin trà nóng làm mát "My grandmother says that too — I've never believed either of you!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GỌI MÓN GÌ, phục vụ sẽ chào 2-3 món và khách từ chối dần. Đợi câu xác nhận dứt khoát "That's the one", "I'll have..." kèm size — đó mới là món được chọn.

question_text: How many weeks did they spend in India?
options: Three weeks
Two weeks
One week
explanation:
W: You two are finally back from India! It felt like you were gone a whole month.
M: Everyone says a month! Our photos do make it look that way.
W: So it wasn't? Your sister told me three weeks.
M: She's wrong too — she never listens. We originally planned just one week, you know, a quick city trip.
W: One week for India? Impossible.
M: Exactly what we realised! So before flying we changed the tickets, and in the end we spent two weeks there. Two full weeks — north the first, south the second.
W: Two weeks... and was it enough?
M: Not even close. Next time, we're doing the full month everyone already believes in!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Two weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "in the end we spent two weeks there. Two full weeks — north the first, south the second."
• Three weeks sai: là lời chị gái nói lại và bị bác ngay ("She's wrong too — she never listens").
• One week sai: chỉ là kế hoạch BAN ĐẦU, họ đã đổi vé trước khi bay ("We originally planned just one week").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thời lượng thực tế, bỏ số gắn với "planned", "someone told me"; chọn số đi với "in the end / actually".

question_text: Listen to the conversation about the directions. Where is the library located?
options: On the left of the square
In front of the square
Behind the square
explanation:
M: Excuse me — I'm completely lost. Could you point me to the public library?
W: Of course! You're actually very close. You know the main square, with the fountain?
M: I just came from there — I walked all around it and saw no library!
W: Everyone does that! People expect it in front of the square, where the big white building is — but that's the courthouse.
M: Ah! And I did wander behind the square too, past the church...
W: That's just the old school back there. No — face the fountain, then look to your left. The library is on the left of the square — the red brick building with the round windows and the book statue outside.
M: On the LEFT! The red one — I must have looked straight past it twice.
W: Happens every day. Tell them Marta sent you — my sister works at the front desk!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On the left of the square (bên trái quảng trường).
• Vì sao đúng: người phụ nữ chỉ đường "face the fountain, then look to your left. The library is on the left of the square — the red brick building with the round windows and the book statue outside".
• In front of the square sai: tòa nhà trắng phía trước là tòa án "People expect it in front of the square, where the big white building is — but that's the courthouse".
• Behind the square sai: phía sau chỉ là trường học cũ "That's just the old school back there".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CHỈ ĐƯỜNG, mỗi vị trí sai đều được gán cho một tòa nhà khác (courthouse, old school). Ghi nhanh cặp "vị trí – tòa nhà" và chọn vị trí gắn với đúng tên nơi cần tìm.

question_text: A woman is talking about her old manager. Why did she like George?
options: He looked after his staff
He was friendly
He taught her a lot
explanation:
A lot of people don't like their managers, but that wasn't the case for me. My manager George was really good at his job — he helped me know what to do in difficult times. He was a friendly manager, and he looked after his staff, too. But those aren't the main reasons I liked him. He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He taught her a lot.
• Vì sao đúng: "He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most".
• He was friendly / He looked after his staff sai: đều được nhắc nhưng bị gạt — "those aren't the main reasons".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "nhắc cả 3 rồi loại 2" — đáp án nằm sau "But... the main reason" / "That's what mattered most".

question_text: Jane is calling her friend Martha. What time are they going to meet?
explanation:
W: Martha! It's Jane — about our gallery evening, we need to fix the time properly.
W2: Finally! Weren't we saying four o'clock at some point?
W: Four was the plan before my shift changed — I'm at the clinic until five now, no escape.
W2: Right. Then straight to six? The gallery closes at eight, that still gives us two hours.
W: Six cuts it fine, though — the guided tour starts at six and we'd miss the introduction rushing in.
W2: True, and you HATE missing introductions. So...?
W: Half past five! I finish at five, fifteen minutes to get there, fifteen minutes for coffee in the courtyard first.
W2: Five thirty with courtyard coffee — now THAT's a plan. I'll buy the tickets online today.
W: Perfect. Five thirty, gallery steps. Wear the comfortable shoes this time!
